25600.meaning1: contact with the nose; olfactory impression; nasal experience
25600.commentary: (NIDD1a) sotato pavatto samphasso sotasamphasso. ghānasamphassādīsupi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, phasso? cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, phassakāyā, cakkhusamphasso, sotasamphasso, ghānasamphasso, jivhāsamphasso, kāyasamphasso, manosamphasso. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, phasso.
cakkhusamphasso… sotasamphasso… ghānasamphasso… jivhāsamphasso… kāyasamphasso… manosamphasso loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etth'esā taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati, ettha nivisamānā nivisati

25601.meaning1: caused by contact with the nose; produced by olfactory impression; born from smell experience

examples.text: cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, vedanākāyā, cakkhusamphassajā vedanā, sotasamphassajā vedanā, ghānasamphassajā vedanā, kāyasamphassajā vedanā, manosamphassajā vedanā.

25602.grammar: ind, comp, adv, abl sg of ghānasamphassapaccaya
25602.meaning1: dependent on contact with the nose; due to olfactory impression
25602.construction:
ghāna + samphassa + paccaya + ā
ghānasamphassapaccaya + ā

examples.text: ghānasmiṃ sati ghānasamphassapaccayā uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhaṃ dukkhaṃ. jivhāya sati jivhāsamphassapaccayā
ghānaṃ aññato passati, gandhe aññato passati, ghānaviññāṇaṃ aññato passati, ghānasamphassaṃ aññato passati, yam'p'idaṃ ghānasamphassapaccayā

25603.meaning1: nasal experience and the corresponding field of consciousness; olfactory impression and the associated dimension of knowing
25603.commentary: (SNa) cakkhusamphassa-viññāṇ'āyatanan'ti cakkhuviññāṇena sampayutto cakkhusamphasso'pi viññāṇ'āyatanam'pi mam'evā'ti. ettha ca cakkhusamphassena viññāṇasampayuttakā dhammā gahitā, viññāṇ'āyatanena sabbāni'pi cakkhudvāre uppannāni āvajjan'ādiviññāṇāni. sotadvār'ādīsu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: tav'eva, pāpima, ghānaṃ, tava gandhā, tava ghānasamphassa-viññāṇ'āyatanaṃ. yattha ca kho, pāpima, n'atthi ghānaṃ, n'atthi gandhā, n'atthi ghānasamphassa-viññāṇ'āyatanaṃ, agati tava tattha, pāpima.

cakkhusamphass'āyatanaṃ, sotasamphass'āyatanaṃ, ghānasamphass'āyatanaṃ, jivhāsamphass'āyatanaṃ, kāyasamphass'āyatanaṃ, manosamphass'āyatanaṃ. chaphass'āyatano ayaṃ, bhikkhu, puriso'ti, iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idam'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.

25605.commentary: (MNa) viññāṇavāre cakkhuviññāṇan'ti cakkhumhi viññāṇaṃ, cakkhuto vā jātaṃ viññāṇan'ti cakkhuviññāṇaṃ. evaṃ sota-ghāna-jivhā-kāya-viññāṇāni.

examples.text: yo'pi hetu yo'pi paccayo ghānaviññāṇassa aññathābhāvi uppādāya, so'pi hetu so'pi paccayo anicco vipariṇāmi aññathābhāvi. aniccaṃ kho pana, bhikkhave, paccayaṃ paṭicca samuppannaṃ ghānaviññāṇaṃ kuto niccaṃ bhavissati.
cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, viññāṇakāyā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ sotaviññāṇaṃ ghānaviññāṇaṃ jivhāviññāṇaṃ kāyaviññāṇaṃ manoviññāṇaṃ idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ

aṭṭhārasa kho imā, ānanda, dhātuyo, cakkhudhātu, rūpadhātu, cakkhuviññāṇadhātu, sotadhātu, saddadhātu, sotaviññāṇadhātu, ghānadhātu, gandhadhātu, ghānaviññāṇadhātu, jivhādhātu, rasadhātu, jivhāviññāṇadhātu, kāyadhātu, phoṭṭhabbadhātu, kāyaviññāṇadhātu, manodhātu, dhammadhātu, manoviññāṇadhātu.

25607.meaningLit: to be known by nose knowing

examples.text: ghānaṃ, āvuso channa, ghānaviññāṇaṃ ghānaviññāṇaviññātabbe dhamme etaṃ mama, eso'ham'asmi, eso me attā'ti samanupassasi?

25608.meaningLit: to be known by the nose

examples.text: ye te ghānaviññeyyā gandhā aghāyitā aghāyitapubbā, na ca ghāyasi, na ca te hoti ghāyeyyan'ti? atthi te tattha chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.
bhusā ce'pi ghānaviññeyyā gandhā ghānassa āpāthaṃ āgacchanti, n'ev'assa cittaṃ pariyādiyanti. amissīkatam'ev'assa cittaṃ hoti ṭhitaṃ āneñjappattaṃ vayañ'c'ass'ānupassati.

25609.meaning1: field of the nose; olfactory sphere

examples.text: katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, saḷāyatanaṃ? cakkh'āyatanaṃ, sot'āyatanaṃ, ghān'āyatanaṃ, jivh'āyatanaṃ, kāy'āyatanaṃ, man'āyatanaṃ, idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, saḷāyatanaṃ.
cha ajjhattikāni āyatanāni veditabbānī'ti, iti kho pan'etaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? cakkh'āyatanaṃ sot'āyatanaṃ ghān'āyatanaṃ jivh'āyatanaṃ kāy'āyatanaṃ man'āyatanaṃ
tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjissāma, rakkhissāma ghān'indriyaṃ, ghān'indriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjissāma
pañc'imāni, bho gotama, indriyāni nānāvisayāni nānāgocarāni, na aññam'aññassa gocaravisayaṃ paccanubhonti. katamāni pañca? cakkhu'ndriyaṃ, sot'indriyaṃ, ghān'indriyaṃ, jivh'indriyaṃ, kāy'indriyaṃ.

25611.meaning1: restraint of the sense of smell

25612.meaning1: with the sense of smell restrained

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhā yoniso cakkhu'ndriyasaṃvarasaṃvuto… sot'indriyasaṃvarasaṃvuto… ghān'indriyasaṃvarasaṃvuto… jivh'indriyasaṃvarasaṃvuto… kāy'indriyasaṃvarasaṃvuto… man'indriyasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati.
ye te ghānaviññeyyā gandhā aghāyitā aghāyitapubbā, na ca ghāyasi, na ca te hoti ghāyeyyan'ti? atthi te tattha chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

seyyathā'pi, bho, puriso candanaghaṭikaṃ adhigaccheyya, haricandanassa vā lohitacandanassa vā. so yato yato ghāyetha, yadi mūlato, yadi majjhato, yadi aggato, adhigacchat'eva surabhigandhaṃ asecanakaṃ
yath'āssa ghāyato gandhaṃ, sevato c'āpi vedanaṃ, khīyati n'opacīyati, evaṃ so caratī sato, evaṃ apacinato dukkhaṃ, santike nibbānam'uccati.
sutaṃ nāma sotena sutaṃ. mutaṃ nāma ghānena ghāyitaṃ, jivhāya sāyitaṃ, kāyena phuṭṭhaṃ. viññātaṃ nāma manasā viññātaṃ.
puna caparaṃ, ānanda, bhikkhuno ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyitvā uppajjati manāpaṃ, uppajjati amanāpaṃ, uppajjati manāp'āmanāpaṃ.
ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyitvā piyarūpe gandhe adhimuccati, appiyarūpe gandhe byāpajjati, anupaṭṭhitakāyassati ca viharati parittacetaso.
ye te ghānaviññeyyā gandhā aghāyitā aghāyitapubbā, na ca ghāyasi, na ca te hoti ghāyeyyan'ti? atthi te tattha chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.
asantaṃ yo paggaṇhāti, asantaṃ c'ūpasevati, tam'eva ghāsaṃ kurute, byaggho sañjīvako yathā'ti.
bhuñjati anavajjāni, sāvajjāni na bhuñjati, ghāsam'acchādanaṃ laddhā, sannidhiṃ parivajjayaṃ.

25622.commentary: (ANa) ghāsacchādo labbhatī'ti yasmiṃ kule dukkhena yāgubhattaghāso ca kopīnamattaṃ acchādanañ'ca labbhati.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo nīce kule paccājāto hoti, caṇḍālakule vā venakule vā nesādakule vā rathakārakule vā pukkusakule vā dalidde app'annapānabhojane kasiravuttike, yattha kasirena ghāsacchādo labbhati.
idha me, bho gotama, yaṃ ahosi dhanaṃ vā dhaññaṃ vā rajataṃ vā jātarūpaṃ vā sabbaṃ taṃ puttānaṃ dāyajjaṃ niyyātaṃ, tatth'āhaṃ anovādī anupavādī ghāsacchādanaparamo viharāmi.

25624.meaning1: with nothing more than food and clothing; with food and clothing at most
25624.commentary: (MNa) ghāsacchādanaparamo viharāmī'ti ghāsamattañ'c'eva acchādanamattañ'ca paramaṃ katvā viharāmi, tato paraṃ n'atthi, na ca patthemī'ti dīpeti.

examples.text: idha me, bho gotama, yaṃ ahosi dhanaṃ vā dhaññaṃ vā rajataṃ vā jātarūpaṃ vā sabbaṃ taṃ puttānaṃ dāyajjaṃ niyyātaṃ, tatth'āhaṃ anovādī anupavādī ghāsacchādanaparamo viharāmi.

25625.meaning1: food and clothes at the most; nothing more than food and clothing
25625.meaning2: food and clothes at the most; nothing more than food and clothing
25625.commentary: (DNa) ghāsacchādanaparamatāyā'ti ghāsacchādanena paramatāya uttamatāya, etadattham'pi anesanaṃ pahāya aggasallekhena santuṭṭho'ti attho.

examples.text: so evaṃ pabbajito samāno kāyena saṃvuto viharati, vācāya saṃvuto viharati, manasā saṃvuto viharati, ghāsacchādanaparamatāya santuṭṭho, abhirato paviveke'ti.

25626.meaning2: having or wanting nothing more than (mere) food and clothing

examples.text: bhuñjati anavajjāni, sāvajjāni na bhuñjati, ghāsam'acchādanaṃ laddhā, sannidhiṃ parivajjayaṃ.

25628.meaning1: seeking food; looking for a meal

examples.text: te araññ'āyatane paṇṇakuṭiyo karitvā paṇṇakuṭīsu jhāyanti vīt'aṅgārā vītadhūmā pannamusalā sāyaṃ sāyam'āsāya pāto pātarāsāya gāmanigamarājadhāniyo osaranti ghāsam'esanā. te ghāsaṃ paṭilabhitvā puna'd'eva araññ'āyatane paṇṇakuṭīsu jhāyanti.

25629.meaning1: seeking food; looking for a meal

examples.text: tam'enaṃ manussā disvā evam'āhaṃsu, ime kho, bho, sattā araññ'āyatane paṇṇakuṭiyo karitvā paṇṇakuṭīsu jhāyanti, vīt'aṅgārā vītadhūmā pannamusalā sāyaṃ sāyam'āsāya pāto pātarāsāya gāmanigamarājadhāniyo osaranti ghāsam'esamānā.

25631.meaning1: looking for food; begging for food; seeking food

examples.text: na munī gāmam'āgamma, kulesu sahasā care, ghās'esanaṃ chinnakatho, na vācaṃ payutaṃ bhaṇe.

25632.meaning2: search for food; begging round; connected with the search for food

examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, sakuṇagghi lāpaṃ sakuṇaṃ sahasā ajjhappattā aggahesi.

25635.meaning1: wheezing; breathing heavily; huffing and puffing
25635.meaning2: breathing with a snort, snoring; wheezing and puffing

examples.text: atha kho māro pāpimā brāhmaṇavaṇṇaṃ abhinimminitvā mahantena jaṭ'aṇḍuvena ajinakkhipanivattho jiṇṇo gopānasivaṅko ghurughurupassāsī udumbaradaṇḍaṃ gahetvā yena te bhikkhū ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā te bhikkhū etadavoca

25636.notes: unattested form found in classical grammars

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena ghoṭamukho brāhmaṇo bārāṇasiṃ anuppatto hoti kenaci'd'eva karaṇīyena. atha kho ghoṭamukho brāhmaṇo jaṅghāvihāraṃ anucaṅkamamāno anuvicaramāno yena khemiy'ambavanaṃ ten'upasaṅkami.
seyyathā'pi, sunakkhatta, āsīviso ghoraviso. atha puriso āgaccheyya jīvitu'kāmo amaritu'kāmo sukhakāmo dukkhapaṭikūlo.
ye keci ariyaṃ dhammaṃ, vigarahantā caranti dummedhā, upenti roruvaṃ ghoraṃ, cirarattaṃ dukkhaṃ anubhavanti.

25642.meaning1: with terrible venom; with dreadful poison

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, sunakkhatta, āsīviso ghoraviso. atha puriso āgaccheyya jīvitu'kāmo amaritu'kāmo sukhakāmo dukkhapaṭikūlo.
siyā hi, bho gotama, āsīvisaṃ ghoravisaṃ āsajja purisassa sotthibhāvo, na tv'eva bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ āsajja siyā purisassa sotthibhāvo.

25643.meaning1: fact of having terrible venom; fact of having dreadful poison

examples.text: kodhano, upanāhī, ghoraviso, dujjivho, mittadubbhī. tatr'idaṃ, bhikkhave, mātugāmassa ghoravisatā, yebhuyyena, bhikkhave, mātugāmo tibbarāgo. tatr'idaṃ, bhikkhave, mātugāmassa dujjivhatā, yebhuyyena, bhikkhave, mātugāmo pisuṇavāco.
aṭṭh'aṅgasamannāgato kho pan'assa bhoto gotamassa mukhato ghoso niccharati, vissaṭṭho ca, viññeyyo ca, mañju ca, savanīyo ca, bindu ca, avisārī ca, gambhīro ca, ninnādī ca.
dve kho, āvuso, paccayā sammādiṭṭhiyā uppādāya, parato ca ghoso, yoniso ca manasikāro. ime kho, āvuso, dve paccayā sammādiṭṭhiyā uppādāyā'ti.
rūpappamāṇo rūpappasanno, ghosappamāṇo ghosappasanno, lūkhappamāṇo lūkhappasanno, dhammappamāṇo dhammappasanno. ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin'ti.
ajjhattañ'ca na jānāti, bahiddhā ca na passati, samant'āvaraṇo bālo, sa ve ghosena vuyhati.
sunīlagīvā susikhā supekhunā, sucittapattacchadanā vihaṅ'gamā, sumañjughosatthanit'ābhigajjino, te taṃ ramessanti vanamhi jhāyinaṃ.

25647.meaning1: (gram) voiced (letter); sonant; g gh ṇ; j jh ñ; ḍa ḍh ṇ; d dh n; b bh m; y r l v h ḷ

examples.text: ḷ'ant'āññe ghosā.
ghosa-aghosa-saññā ca parasamaññā payoge'ti saṅgahītā.

25650.grammar: fem, abstr, act, from ghoseti, caus

25651.meaning1: who measures by fame; appraising by reputation; who judges on the basis of fame

examples.text: rūpappamāṇo rūpappasanno, ghosappamāṇo ghosappasanno, lūkhappamāṇo lūkhappasanno, dhammappamāṇo dhammappasanno. ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin'ti.

25652.meaning1: who has confidence in fame; whose faith is based on reputation; pleased by good report

examples.text: rūpappamāṇo rūpappasanno, ghosappamāṇo ghosappasanno, lūkhappamāṇo lūkhappasanno, dhammappamāṇo dhammappasanno. ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin'ti.
tatth'āhaṃ divase tikkhattuṃ, ghosāpemi tahiṃ tahiṃ, ko kiṃ icchati pattheti, kassa kiṃ dīyatū dhanaṃ.
ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ca ānando āyasmā ca udāyī kosambiyaṃ viharanti ghosita-ārāme.
kileseh'ābhibhūtā te, tena tena vidhāvitā, narā kilesavatthūsu, sasaṅgāme'va ghosite.

25656.meaning1: name of a monastery in Kosambī
25656.commentary: (MNa) ghosit'ārāme'ti ghositassa ārāme. ghositanāmakena kira seṭṭhinā so kārito, tasmā ghosit'ārāmo'ti vuccati.

examples.text: ekaṃ samayaṃ sambahulā therā bhikkhū kosambiyaṃ viharanti ghosit'ārāme. tena kho pana samayena āyasmā khemako badarik'ārāme viharati ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ānando kosambiyaṃ viharati ghosit'ārāme. tatra kho āyasmā ānando bhikkhū āmantesi, āvuso bhikkhave'ti. āvuso'ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato ānandassa paccassosuṃ.

25658.meaning2: having shouted, having announced, having proclaimed

examples.text: dvīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bālo abyatto asappuriso khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo ca viññūnaṃ bahuñ'ca apuññaṃ pasavati
n'atthi jhānaṃ apaññassa, paññā n'atthi ajhāyato, yamhi jhānañ'ca paññā ca, sa ve nibbānasantike.
na hi verena verāni, sammant'īdha kudācanaṃ, averena ca sammanti, esa dhammo sanantano.

25664.meaning1: (gram) and; as well as; but; terms and conditions apply to a rule

examples.text: 317, 332. tesaṃ vibhattiyo lopā ca.

25665.meaning1: (gram) letter c; 14th letter of the alphabet; palatal consonant

examples.text: byañjan'antassa dhātussa co hoti chapaccayesu paresu. jigucchati, tikicchati, jighacchati.
kvaci caādese, paradvebhāvo ṭhāne'ti
(ca) katamo eko dhammo visesabhāgiyo? yoniso manasikāro. ayaṃ eko dhammo visesabhāgiyo.

25667.meaning1: (gram) letter c; 14th letter of the alphabet; palatal consonant

examples.text: vipassissa ca [ime cakārā porāṇapotthakesu n'atthi]
manopubbaṅ'gamā dhammā, manoseṭṭhā manomayā, manasā ce paduṭṭhena, bhāsati vā karoti vā, tato naṃ dukkham'anveti, cakkaṃ'va vahato padaṃ.
heṭṭhā kho pana tassa bhoto gotamassa pādatalesu cakkāni jātāni sahass'ārāni sanemikāni sanābhikāni sabb'ākāraparipūrāni, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhayaṃ hoti aṭavisaṅkopo, cakkasamārūḷhā jānapadā pariyāyanti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, catuttho asamayo padhānāya.

atha naṃ āha, amma, kāḷi imasmiṃ nagare pañca sakaṭasatāni paccūsakāle uṭṭhāya vāṇijjāya gacchanti, tvaṃ imaṃ netvā cakkamagge nipajjāpehi, goṇā vā naṃ maddissanti, cakkā vā chindissanti, pavattiṃ c'assa ñatvāva āgaccheyyāsī'ti.

tasmiṃ samaye satthā pavattitavaradhammacakko anupubben'āgantvā anāthapiṇḍikena mahāseṭṭhinā catupaṇṇāsakoṭidhanaṃ vissajjetvā kārite jetavanamahāvihāre viharati mahājanaṃ saggamagge ca mokkhamagge ca patiṭṭhāpayamāno.

yo'pi so, bhikkhave, rājā cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā so'pi na arājakaṃ cakkaṃ vattetī'ti. evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, ko pana, bhante, rañño cakkavattissa dhammikassa dhammarañño rājā'ti?
evaṃ vutte āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, idāni, bhante, pañcamattāni sakaṭasatāni atikkantāni, taṃ cakkacchinnaṃ udakaṃ parittaṃ luḷitaṃ āvilaṃ sandati.
api c'āhaṃ āyasmato cakkanemisaddena tamhā samādhimhā vuṭṭhito'ti.

25679.meaning2: God Vishnu (in whose hand is a disc)

25681.meaning2: breaking the wheels of authority; destroying the unity or sway of the religion

examples.text: atha kho, bhikkhave, rājā sacetano rathakāraṃ āmantesi, ito me, samma rathakāra, channaṃ māsānaṃ accayena saṅgāmo bhavissati. sakkhissasi me, samma rathakāra, navaṃ cakkayugaṃ kātun'ti? sakkomi devā'ti kho, bhikkhave, rathakāro rañño sacetanassa paccassosi.
sovaṇṇamayo pabhassaro, uppanno rathapañjaro mama, tassa cakkayugaṃ na vindāmi, tena dukkhena jahāmi jīvitan'ti.

25684.meaning1: jewelled wheel; wheel treasure; one of the seven treasures of a universal ruler
25684.meaning2: jewel wheel of a universal monarch

examples.text: addasā kho, bhikkhave, so puriso bahunnaṃ vassānaṃ bahunnaṃ vassasatānaṃ bahunnaṃ vassasahassānaṃ accayena dibbaṃ cakkaratanaṃ osakkitaṃ ṭhānā cutaṃ
idh'ānanda, rañño mahāsudassanassa tadah'uposathe pannarase sīsaṃ nhātassa uposathikassa uparipāsādavaragatassa dibbaṃ cakkaratanaṃ pāturahosi sahass'āraṃ sanemikaṃ sanābhikaṃ sabbākāraparipūraṃ.

25688.commentary: (ANa) cakkasamārūḷhā'ti ettha iriyāpathacakkam'pi vaṭṭati yānacakkam'pi. bhayasmiṃ hi sampatte yesaṃ yānakāni atthi, te attano parikkhārabhaṇḍaṃ tesu āropetvā palāyanti. yesaṃ n'atthi, te kājena vā ādāya sīsena vā ukkhipitvā palāyanti'y'eva. te cakkasamārūḷhā nāma honti.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, hoti so samayo yaṃ bhayaṃ hoti aṭavisaṅkopo, cakkasamāruḷhā jānapadā pariyāyanti. bhaye kho pana, bhikkhave, sati aṭavisaṅkope cakkasamāruḷhesu jānapadesu pariyāyantesu tattha mātā'pi puttaṃ nappaṭilabhati, putto'pi mātaraṃ nappaṭilabhati.

25689.meaning2: having mounted their vehicles (in an emergency)
25689.commentary: (ANa) cakkasamārūḷhā'ti ettha iriyāpathacakkam'pi vaṭṭati yānacakkam'pi. bhayasmiṃ hi sampatte yesaṃ yānakāni atthi, te attano parikkhārabhaṇḍaṃ tesu āropetvā palāyanti. yesaṃ n'atthi, te kājena vā ādāya sīsena vā ukkhipitvā palāyanti'y'eva. te cakkasamārūḷhā nāma honti.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhayaṃ hoti aṭavisaṅkopo, cakkasamārūḷhā jānapadā pariyāyanti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, catuttho asamayo padhānāya.

25692.meaning2: wheeled device for raising water from a well, noria

25693.meaningLit: discourse on the marvellous qualities of an emperor

examples.text: yathā ca dhataraṭṭho suvaṇṇahaṃso na gāmadvāre āvāṭak'ādīsu paṭivasati, navutihaṃsasahassaparivāro hutvā cittakūṭapabbate'y'eva paṭivasati. yathā ca catuddīp'issaro cakkavattirājā na nīcakule uppajjati, asambhinnajāti-khattiyakule'y'eva pana uppajjati.
